#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'optparse'

verbose = false
options = OptionParser.new do |parser|
  parser.banner = 'Usage: wordcount.rb [--verbose] FILENAME'
  parser.on('--verbose', 'Also print the number of lines') { verbose = true }
end

begin
  options.parse!
  abort options.to_s unless ARGV.length == 1

  words = 0
  lines = 0
  File.foreach(ARGV.first) do |line|
    words += line.split.length
    lines += 1
  end

  puts "Words: #{words}"
  puts "Lines: #{lines}" if verbose
rescue OptionParser::ParseError, SystemCallError => e
  abort e.message
end
